traced_divergences.cause: perception threshold in code: on day 7 the bloomed-out nectar site F08 holds 0.000002 份 (baseline) vs 0.000019 份 (×10); sourceSum(site) <= 1e-5 makes it "empty" only in the baseline, so W009 finds nothing there in one run and discovers nectar in the other

rounding: the collect duration is proportional to the rounded load (0.187246 vs 1.872458 份), so the activity ends at minute 15.411765 vs 15.411764; two events at minute 15.882352/3 are then processed in a different order
